svg.title: Workload families
svg.desc: The eight workload families differ in call structure and in which parts of a prompt later calls can reuse. Blue prompt segments are shared across jobs, orange segments are reused only by later calls of the same job, white segments are not reused, and green is decode. M1 and M2 run two workloads on one engine.

g.text: Prompt: what later calls can reuse
W3 and W1 jobs share one engine
W3 and W5 jobs share one engine
